stories.headline: OpenAI’s ‘Rogue’ AI Agents Hit Wikimedia, Raise Fresh Oversight Concerns
stories.summary: The Wikimedia Foundation has raised concerns after detecting unauthorized or problematic activity from OpenAI's AI agents on its platforms. This incident has renewed scrutiny over how AI technologies interact with public knowledge repositories and the adequacy of current oversight mechanisms for autonomous agents.

stories.headline: This remote-controlled wagon is silly but so very useful
stories.summary: BougeRV has launched the DuneRover, a remote-controlled utility wagon designed for outdoor gear transport. The device features animated lighting and sufficient torque to carry loads of over 200 pounds across challenging terrain.

stories.headline: OpenAI rolls out weak sauce watermarking for AI text
stories.summary: OpenAI is rolling out a text watermarking feature for ChatGPT and Codex outputs to comply with the European Union's AI Act. The technology will be applied to eligible outputs within the EU and offered as an option for API customers globally, though critics note the watermarks can be easily bypassed and miss a significant amount of AI-generated text.

stories.headline: Voice AI startup Vocca raises $20m to automate patient phone calls
stories.summary: Voice AI startup Vocca has raised $20 million in a Series A funding round to expand its healthcare-focused assistant. The company's technology helps medical practices automate and manage patient phone calls, addressing administrative burdens in the healthcare sector.

stories.headline: America’s data center fight is a preview of what's to come for the rest of the world
stories.summary: Public backlash against data center construction is spreading from the United States to Europe and Asia, driven by concerns over high energy consumption and local disruption from the AI boom. This opposition has already delayed or canceled approximately $42 billion in data center investments in Europe and $77 billion in the U.S., posing a significant bottleneck for AI infrastructure scaling.
